item.case_name: Stage 1 on the MCP: Join two clips with a dissolve
item.title: Join two clips with a dissolve

turns.text: Join these two clips in this order with a soft dissolve between them.
Join these two clips in this order with a soft dissolve between them.
turns.agent:
I can’t directly join clips with the connected Magic Hour tools—they don’t support timeline editing or dissolves.

In a video editor, place **barber-seed.mp4** first, then **v4-classroom-wipe.mp4**, and add a **0.5-second cross-dissolve** at the cut. This will blend them softly in the requested order.
